bullets.text: Anbumani Ramadoss warned that constructing a boundary wall in the Pallikaranai marshland will cause disaster, and the office should monitor wetland protection.
The State Wetlands Authority told the Madras High Court that the interim zone of influence around the Pallikaranai marshland can be restricted to 36 survey numbers.
Residents in Pallikaranai appealed to leader Anbumani Ramadoss to arrange proper water flow paths, and the office should watch drainage clearance.
The state highways department is desilting and clearing three culverts along Jawaharlal Nehru Salai near Velachery MRTS station to flood-proof Velachery.
Doctor Karthik in Govardhanagiri, Pallikaranai reported stolen cash and jewelry, leading to the arrest of a maid and her lover by police.
Residents gathered in large numbers to witness blue glowing waves of bioluminescence along ECR beaches in Tiruvanmiyur and Akkarai.
Residents in Poonamallee municipality are facing hardships due to continuous night time power cuts.
Workers protested and picketed the BDO office in Tiruttani after being paid low wages under the national rural employment guarantee scheme.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched development projects worth over 13,000 crore rupees across Tamil Nadu on October 11, 2026.
R Kirlosh Kumar announced that Tamil Nadu is set to introduce SPEED, an AI-based planning approval software for housing and urban development.
Tamil Nadu is experiencing renewed growth in its Global Capability Centre sector with expansions and new company setups.
Henox IT and Data Centers unveiled the Crest submarine cable system to support AI connectivity and digital infrastructure in India.
Youth Congress members staged a black balloon protest in Chennai over the Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro rail inauguration by Prime Minister Modi and Chief Minister Vijay.
Anbumani Ramadoss criticized TVK for continuing actions similar to DMK regarding the Pallikaranai marshland issue.
TVK MLA ECR P. Saravanan approached the Madras High Court to quash an FIR registered against him in an unauthorized banners case.
Prime Minister Modi pledged continued support from the Centre to Tamil Nadu during the inauguration of projects worth over Rs 13,000 crore.
Passengers showed great enthusiasm for the Poonamallee-Porur-Vadapalani metro service, reporting halved travel time and cost.
